races.paceDynamic: Mick's Spirit will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, as Aleppo Pepper sits prominently but the other three are all hold-up horses. With Lequinto, Spendmore Lane and Ancient State all needing to come from behind, Mick's Spirit can dictate terms and control the gallop over this sharp 5f trip. The lack of early pace pressure means the front runner can save energy for the finish while the hold-up horses face a traffic problem in a small field. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders who can avoid trouble and kick clear when the hold-up brigade get organised too late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mick's Spirit Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Mick's Spirit gets an easy lead and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: The front runner can coast through moderate fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges over this minimum trip. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground in time with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Time Rush
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up trio coordinate their runs and find clear passages
scenarios.body: Ancient State and Spendmore Lane can use their superior recent form to sweep past a tiring Mick's Spirit in the final furlong. The class difference tells when they get their chance to run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Aleppo Pepper Benefits Position
scenarios.trigger: If Aleppo Pepper tracks Mick's Spirit closely and kicks first
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets the best of both worlds, avoiding early pace pressure but positioned to pounce when Mick's Spirit tires. Hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the move.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Helps Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses interfere with each other in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: Limited room for manoeuvre in a five-runner field causes problems for those coming from behind. Early positioned horses have clear runs while others are shuffled back.

watchPoints.text: Mick's Spirit breaking slowly or being challenged early would completely alter the pace scenario
Ancient State and Spendmore Lane getting blocked behind horses in the straight with limited room to manoeuvre

The 54-day layoff for Mick's Spirit potentially showing in the final half-furlong if pressed hard enough
William Carson's ride on Ancient State from the back as any early move would signal strong confidence

races.paceDynamic: Merlier and Comprador will dispute the early lead, with both horses showing consistent front-running tendencies over this 6f trip. Merlier arrives in better form with two recent wins at 5f, while Comprador has been consistent without winning but carries the lowest weight. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop without being destructively fast, as neither leader has shown kamikaze tendencies. This setup favours prominent racers and closers who can benefit from the pace battle ahead of them, particularly those with tactical speed to position well.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Merlier and Comprador go too hard early trying to establish dominance
scenarios.body: The leaders weaken in the final furlong, opening the door for horses with finishing kicks positioned just behind. Hold-up horses like Alasrae and Eternal Solace get the perfect tow into contention.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Merlier Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Merlier gets an uncontested lead with Comprador settling behind
scenarios.body: The favourite dictates fractions and has enough left to repel challengers, with prominent racers getting first run. Archie Watson's 3yo can complete a hat-trick from the front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough to compromise leaders but not severe enough to favour pure closers
scenarios.body: Horses tracking the pace get the perfect trip and kick clear when the leaders falter. The prominent brigade gets ideal positioning to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Comprador Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the 5lb claimer Ashley Lewis settles Comprador perfectly behind Merlier's pace
scenarios.body: The outsider benefits from the weight allowance and gets the perfect stalking trip to strike late. Ed Walker's consistent performer finally breaks his maiden.

Bone Marra's 171-day absence makes him unpredictable despite having ability when fresh and race-fit previously
Alasrae's headgear application suggests connections expect improved effort from this consistent course winner
Merlier faces stronger pace pressure than in recent wins which could compromise his finishing kick
Watch early positioning as prominent racers Rogue Messiah and Akabusi need to avoid getting caught wide

races.paceDynamic: Mortubo and Dusk Damsel will likely set the early tempo from prominent positions, with Calabrian Soldato potentially joining them if connections push forward. The pace should be sustainable rather than destructive given the limited early speed, allowing the field to stay compact through the first half of this 6f sprint. Enter Sandman and Luna Beaux possess the strongest finishing profiles among the hold-up horses, while several runners carry warnings about fading in the finish. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and sustain their effort, as pure hold-up horses may find limited gaps behind a steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and prominent runners maintain position
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows prominent runners to control their effort and kick clear in the final furlong. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground behind the compact pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Luna Beaux or Enter Sandman find clear running room late
scenarios.body: The hold-up specialists use their superior finishing speed to sweep past tiring leaders in the final 100 yards. Their recent form suggests they're well-handicapped.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and allows an outsider to strike
scenarios.body: Power Cut or No Claims Bonus benefit from the low weights and get first run on the field as favourites fail to quicken. The handicapper's big weight concessions prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If early leaders go too fast and multiple horses fade badly
scenarios.body: The warned faders Sun Path, Saddle Up and Calabrian Soldato all empty out, creating a messy finish where any horse still galloping can win. Form goes out the window in a weak finish.

races.paceDynamic: Liveinthelight will set the early tempo alongside Master Dancer, but with only two confirmed pace angles this creates a measured gallop rather than breakneck speed. The majority field sits in hold-up mode (Knights Charge, Mr Bollinger, Leonato, Crimson Dawn) which means minimal early pressure on the leaders. This sets up a tactical affair where the pace will likely quicken significantly in the final 3f as the hold-up brigade makes their moves. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, as pure hold-up horses may find themselves with too much to do from the back when the pace lifts late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Measured pace favours leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Liveinthelight and Master Dancer are allowed soft fractions through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front two to conserve energy and kick clear when the field closes, making it hard for hold-up horses to peg them back. Liveinthelight's prominent style and recent Lingfield form gives her the edge over the veteran Master Dancer.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the Gosden newcomer Cyrano De Bergerac shows typical stable debut sharpness and settles handily
scenarios.body: The son of a top operation often shows up well fresh and the measured pace allows him to travel strongly before quickening late. His unknown ability ceiling combined with Havlin's positioning skills could unlock significant improvement.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse times it right
scenarios.trigger: If Knights Charge or Mr Bollinger get the perfect split and the pace quickens just enough to set it up
scenarios.body: Knights Charge showed decent form last time and Varian's string are running well, while Mr Bollinger has solid recent Polytrack form at this track. The tactical nature suits patient riders who can find the right moment to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete longshot victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish where anything can happen
scenarios.body: In a weak maiden where several runners have question marks, a complete outsider like Shopaholic with unknown ability could capitalize on a slowly-run race that becomes a lottery. The lack of exposed form makes upset results possible.

races.paceDynamic: Romantic Spirit and Etretat are confirmed front runners who will clash from the start, setting honest early fractions over this 1m2f trip. Behind them, Joseph, Criminal, Blue Wonder and Voix De Bocelli all want prominent positions, creating a bunched pack that risks traffic problems turning for home. The sustained pace from dual leaders should set up the race for those able to finish strongly from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can navigate the early congestion and unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Romantic Spirit and Etretat engage in a fierce early duel through honest fractions
scenarios.body: The front two tire badly in the final 2f, allowing closers to sweep past the faltering pace-setters. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed get first run on the weakening leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners successfully avoid early traffic and track the leaders smoothly
scenarios.body: Joseph and Voix De Bocelli get ideal stalking positions behind the dueling leaders, then quicken clear when the pace softens 2f out. The tactical positioning of the prominent group pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Romantic Spirit or Etretat gets an uncontested lead after early skirmishing
scenarios.body: The surviving leader controls the tempo and has enough left to repel late challenges over this stamina-testing trip. Early pace advantage converts to sustained gallop dominance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early while the prominent pack gets shuffled back in traffic
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the hold-up horses who were completely out of the early pace battle. Patient jockeyship and closing kicks become the only winning formula.

races.paceDynamic: Katalyst will lead from the gate with no serious pace pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner facing five hold-up/prominent runners. This creates a sustainable tempo that allows Katalyst to dictate terms through steady fractions. With Labiche the only prominent runner to potentially apply some pressure, the pace will likely be controlled rather than searching. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, while hold-up horses face the challenge of a potentially slow tempo that may not provide enough kickback.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Katalyst gets an easy lead and dictates steady fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: Katalyst can control the race from pillar to post, while any prominent racer like Labiche benefits from the honest pace. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Labiche or another runner challenges Katalyst early, creating faster fractions
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits hold-up horses who get the pace collapse they need in the final stages. Wild Thoughts and Timely Salute can benefit from the stronger gallop despite their finishing concerns.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If no one wants to engage with Katalyst, creating an overly slow early pace
scenarios.body: The lack of pace becomes extreme, turning it into a sprint finish that favours the best raw speed regardless of style. Horses with higher RPR ratings like Wild Thoughts gain an edge in the dash.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Challenge Surge
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses find their rhythm simultaneously in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as several closers hit the line together after getting the perfect setup. Bennyworth and Betty Lemon could outrun their odds with strong late kicks.
